base_score: The ordinary deck total sums three float score parameters for every active member.
Ordinary and Free Live event-bonus base scores use the same play-level and maximum-Note formula.
NoteManager.analyzeBMS writes InGameRecord.maxNoteCount before InGameManager calls InitBaseScore.
Long tails and visible Slide nodes contribute to maximum Note count.
Game Over decrease routing depends on multiplayer/single flags, mode, Practice, and collaboration-original-music state.
Team Live Festival and Auto Live bypass standard result correction in NoteBase.calcBaseCorrectedScore.
Eligible real-value score Skill effects add a truncated fixed value after result correction.
The upstream Free Live event-bonus deck construction is continued and integrated by ../free-live-event-bonus-construction/free_live_event_bonus_construction.json.
event_score: Ordinary and Free Live event-bonus scores share Combo and ScoreUpRate correction.
Festival stage effect multiplies only the ordinary corrected score.
Judge, Combo, and Life stage rates always multiply together.
Stage type changes only the selected display level.
Combo and Life ranges are inclusive.
The two one-note maximum records are independent and retain the first equal maximum.
free_event: RhythmGameStartData owns the Free Live event-bonus total parameter backing field at +0x88.
Only Versus and Festival event types construct and store this bonus in the recovered setup path.
Area Item and event-buff deltas remain separately accumulated before the aggregate getter adds them to original totals.
Event parameter percentage applies to original member parameters.
The prototype can feed the structured deck profile directly into base-score initialization.
The normal PostRhythmGame coroutine is the only direct caller of the public clear method and clears the backing field before its screen transition.
Event parameter percentage is the sum of character attribute conditional paired situation and limit-break sources.
The flat event value is an original-parameter weighted percentage gated by event character and attribute matches and routed by positive-field priority.
special_combo: ButtonType.None bypasses Auto Live and every mode-specific controller.
Auto Live bypasses the mode switch.
Team Live Festival Combo correction is 1.0.
Only Garupa Cup first qualification uses the qualification calculator.
Medley and Garupa Cup use inclusive ordered ranges and fall back to 1.0.

one_frame.score_up_rate_storage: Setup multiplies Fever, Skill, and Crescendo rates in ARM64 Float32 order and stores the product at +0x58.

reflect.slot_scan: The managed five-entry list is scanned by ascending list index.
reflect.clear_point: Each in-use entry has isUsing cleared before Combo, score, Life, counters, callbacks, and total aggregation mutate.
reflect.representative: A strictly greater raw result replaces the representative; equal raw result retains the first entry.
mutation_order: select Combo correction from updated current Combo
truncate addScore * comboRate toward zero to int32
multiply truncated value by stored ScoreUpRate
reflect.integer_semantics: Score additions are uint32 modulo-2^32; Combo and Life arithmetic use int32 ARM64 operations.

damage.skill_order: NoteFrontBase applies ordered active damage effects after selecting base damage and before OneFrameData Setup.

never_die.replacement_delta: For lethal damage, return 5 - currentLife; otherwise preserve signedDamage.
never_die.guard_type: The Never Die path selects DamageGuardType 2.

once_heal.eligibility: Only once-effect type 1 enters Life mutation; condition type 1 suppresses the effect when current Life is greater than or equal to the condition value.
once_heal.fixed: Truncate the Float32 effect value toward zero to int32 and pass it to AddIPower.
once_heal.percentage: Compute int32(+0x24) * truncFloatToInt(effectValue), then signed-divide by 100 using the compiler strength-reduced sequence, and pass the result to AddIPower.
once_heal.upper_limit: AddIPower clamps the resulting current Life to +0x28, not +0x24.
once_heal.callback: The registered heal callback runs after AddIPower or after the no-operation once-effect branch.

skill_state.states: The mapped enum is None=0, Begin=1, Playing=2, Finishing=3.
skill_state.playing_timer: +0x88 is reduced by the engine delta except in game states 7 and 8.
skill_state.transition: At +0x88 <= 0, processOfSkillFinished runs and +0x8C is initialized from exact bits 0x3F400000 (0.75f).
skill_state.finishing_timer: +0x8C is reduced by the engine delta and transitions to the next queued state at expiry.
skill_state.runtime_pending: Same-frame callbacks, reservation frame identity, pause/Game Over observations, and queue object identity remain R1 requirements.

fever_rate.state_test: Return 2.0f only when Fever state at +0x4C equals 1; otherwise return 1.0f.
fever_rate.runtime_pending: Difficulty point rows, own-team identity, command/callback/reservation order, and same-frame freezing remain B02 requirements.

record.combo: Positive addCombo updates current/max and live current/max using strict greater for maxima; negative addCombo resets current and live current to zero; zero is a no-op.
record.results: Miss/Bad/Good/Great each reset perfectCombo and increment their counter; Perfect increments both perfectCombo and perfectCount.
record.timing: JudgeTiming 1 increments Fast and JudgeTiming 2 increments Slow; all other values are no-op.

caller_required: deck parameter components or validated member rows
Medley and Garupa ordered combo ranges
